{{Top}}
'''Naescorcom''' was a manufacturing conglomerate led by seven core members from [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. At the suggestion of two of its members, the company established a large manufacturing facility&mdash;the floating city [[Ipsus]]&mdash;on [[Genarius]] in [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. The [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system's]] position would allow easy distribution of product to both the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] and Outer Rim, and also points in between.<ref name="LFC">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

As some of the representatives were reluctant to take the risk, Naescorcom agreed to commit an initial 50,000,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] budget to build Ipsus, pending the first gain (which had not been reached as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]). Furthermore, a Naescorcom board was to become the remote ruling body of Ipsus city, and the facilities would be managed by two Naescorcom operation overseers destined there.<ref name="LFC" />

Naescorcom believed that diversification in product lines would lead to success. Their manufacturing facilities often produced multiple items that had little relation. Ipsus, for example, produced textiles and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].<ref name="LFC" />

Naescorcom was also known for their strict practices: When they found that [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Loa Tibeeme]] had been among the slicers who stole secret data from them, Naescorcom offered Tibeeme a "forced" employment as a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] security agent in Ipsus, to pay for her crime. Tibeeme was forced to accept the deal. Other employees, such as Ipsus's Line Two archivist [[Nui Gneppe]], worked there by their own will.<ref name="LFC" />

Naescorcom leaders of Ipsus had claimed [[Mining/Legends|mining]] rights on the inhospitable [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Ulbasca]], disputing the rights of rival company [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]], even though none of them have ever made a real effort to mine there.<ref name="LFC" />

At some point before 32 BBY, Naescorcom employed [[El'Tar Miskin]] as a shipping clerk, but he mixed up two shipments, sending textiles to Outer Rim [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and thermal detonators to a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] orphanage. Miskin could have been executed for the failure, but he was instead fired.<ref name="LFC" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Naesorcomm hired [[Renna's Transport Service]] to deliver them a shipment of thermal detonator components. However, the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] carrying the shipment was captured by the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]].<ref name="Outward Bound">{{LivingForce|Looking In: Outward Bound}}</ref>
